review_tasks.disposition: Recorded installed Steam experimental 2.1.20.87512 with executable SHA-256 E4B1FDBDCC77F4C3449318CE1398493EA7A8E77A19D68BD1AC3A858D0F373B92, runtime API SHA-256 1FF275CC085347FAFDDC01B5BA53DF10259319339E78CD6E5B4E0D067E1DAEB6, prototype API SHA-256 5D2AAB6483F33D1582D2FDFD661B4B9F6FF6A1F97548311524D062ECC32F200B, and changelog SHA-256 20F980C654DD0D3CDE1BDF3DEEF606F6B000E3238CF69C7A21E3CD83BFA66392.

Reviewed all 80 installed changelog entries after 2.1.17: 47 from 2.1.18, one from 2.1.19, and 32 from 2.1.20. The 21 change, modding, or scripting entries were given explicit API, opportunity, fixture, and compatibility dispositions.

The runtime document changed from 2.1.17 SHA-256 2E1FD436404B712AF6FE7B6C53E21A8F5688092A9E132FD2A5571327A96E5211 with 382 surfaces to 2.1.20 SHA-256 1FF275CC085347FAFDDC01B5BA53DF10259319339E78CD6E5B4E0D067E1DAEB6 with 383 surfaces. Reviewed LuaPlayer spectator removal, LuaItemPrototype fuel_categories replacement, and new GUI, transport-line, and render APIs; no MIR runtime call site uses a removed or replaced member.

The prototype document changed from 2.1.17 SHA-256 156F33CB4BC7EE2C538BB93F291F5270F2CDC45BE654BBE6F226E402BF8F5368 to 2.1.20 SHA-256 5D2AAB6483F33D1582D2FDFD661B4B9F6FF6A1F97548311524D062ECC32F200B while retaining 982 surfaces. Reviewed SpaceConnection and SpaceLocation origin additions, science-capacity additions, and fuel-category replacement; MIR's SpaceLocation lookup does not read a changed field and no immediate prototype edit is required.

Repository search found no use of the removed zoom-to-world utility constants, LuaPlayer spectator, PollutionSettings max_pollution_to_restore_trees, or replaced singular fuel_category members. The 2.1.20 removals therefore do not require a compatibility migration.

Reviewed SpaceConnection and SpaceLocation origin, info.json migrates_from, science-capacity, quality, and GUI additions. MIR keeps its stable mod identity and does not need these additions for the current fixed-point product; any adoption remains a separately qualified implementation change.

Reviewed Space Age platform payload, health-prerequisite, alert-GUI, and working-sound changes. The base-default F210 continuity scope neither owns Space Age platform behavior nor player GUI changes, so no current product functionality change is admitted.

Retain the base-default predecessor fixture assertions for level three recipe-prod-research_iron-1, current-research identity, fractional completed work, science ingredients, and startup settings. A new exact 2.1.20 predecessor upgrade plus two reloads is required; 2.1.17 execution evidence is not reused.

No direct API migration or performance-specific product change is indicated by the reviewed deltas. The changed engine identity invalidates cross-patch runtime evidence, so fresh exact 2.1.20 base predecessor upgrade and two-reload evidence is required before using this channel review for continuity.

Reviewed chat-coloring, alert-button, and GUI API changes. MIR has no affected player-facing text, locale, or UI contract, so documentation remains accurate without a patch-specific player-facing edit.
The declared F210 minimum remains 2.1.18. MIR adopts no 2.1.19 or 2.1.20-only API, and the review neither raises the floor nor treats 2.1.20 evidence as reusable for another patch.

The installed Steam app manifest records BetaKey experimental for 2.1.20.87512. Keep the latest-installed official experimental selector and the existing stable-transition stop-and-reopen boundary; no stable-channel policy change is made.

No current MIR source, fixture, or test call site uses the reviewed removed or replaced runtime and prototype members; the existing SpaceLocation lookup does not depend on a changed field.
